current_prompt.body:
READ the set S
READ the target value T equal to 40
USE a backtracking algorithm to explore all subsets of S
FOR each subset
    IF the subset sum equals T
        EMIT the subset
        VERIFY the sum
    ENDIF
ENDFOR
COUNT the emitted subsets
REPORT the total number of solutions

current_plan.body:
READ the set S
READ the target value T
INITIALIZE a counter for solutions to zero
EXECUTE a backtracking search to explore all subsets of S
FOR each generated subset
    IF the subset sum equals T
        EMIT the subset
        INCREMENT the solution counter
    ENDIF
ENDFOR
REPORT the total number of solutions
